lines.say: Beta alanine. Why does it make your skin tingle?
Beta alanine raises a molecule in your muscles called carnosine.
Carnosine soaks up the acid that builds up in hard efforts.
So it helps most in efforts lasting about one to four minutes, like high rep sets, rowing or sprints.
For one heavy set of five, it does very little.
Studies used about four to six grams a day, for at least two to four weeks.
The tingle is harmless. Splitting the dose into smaller ones can reduce it.
